title: Calentar
subtitle: Calentar Carbon Heater White 1050 W
category: Home Appliances > Appliances > OFR & Room Heaters
key_features: 3 Directional Heating : 1st Infrared Carbon Heater with 3 directional heating

Far & Medium Range Infrared Heating with Carbon fiber Rods : Carbon heaters distributes heat uniformly across the space, carbon fiber radiates medium and far range infrared heat which delivers warmth in wider area instead of just heating the air around it. The lux intensity is also lower compared to other IR heaters better for a good night sleep.
120 Minutes Sleep Timer : Set it on 30 or 60 or 90 or 120 minutes, the specialized sleep timer in Calenter lets you choose, if you want it off in 30 minutes or after 2 hours.
Triple heat setting : Calenter comes with 3 Carbon Tubes, and all three can be controlled as desired. Total heating power is 350 W single tubes, 700 W double tubes & 1050 W all three tubes.
